question: What are Qnami's current main opportunities? Give short bullet points
answer:
Here are Qnami’s current main opportunities, based on the latest available information:

• Expansion into East Asia — Qnami has entered into commercial partnerships with Quantum Design Japan and Quantum Design Korea to distribute its ProteusQ™ quantum sensing platform in South Korea and Japan, tapping into vibrant research communities in spintronics and nanomagnetism ([quantumzeitgeist.com](https://quantumzeitgeist.com/qnami-partners-with-quantum-design-to-expand-quantum-sensing-technology-to-east-asia/?utm_source=openai)).

• Semiconductor R&D and advanced materials — Qnami’s quantum sensing technology enables nanoscale mapping of material properties, offering significant value in the development of advanced semiconductors. This includes improving performance, reducing rare material usage, and enhancing sustainability in semiconductor design and manufacturing ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/from-niche-to-necessity-quantum-sensings-growing-demand-in-critical-industries/?utm_source=openai)).

• Strategic partnerships and funding — In Q2 2024, Qnami raised CHF 5 million in Series B funding to accelerate commercialization and expand its product portfolio. It also formed a strategic partnership with Zurich Instruments to jointly develop and market advanced quantum sensing solutions ([marketresearchfuture.com](https://www.marketresearchfuture.com/reports/quantum-sensors-market-5273?utm_source=openai)).

• Growing quantum sensing market — The global quantum sensors market is projected to grow significantly, with forecasts estimating a rise from USD 414.6 million in 2025 to nearly USD 1.3 billion by 2035. Key growth drivers include integration with industrial automation, IoT, environmental monitoring, defense, and aerospace applications—areas where Qnami’s diamond-based NV‑center sensors are well-positioned ([gminsights.com](https://www.gminsights.com/industry-analysis/quantum-sensors-market?utm_source=openai)).

• Distributed quantum sensing architectures — Qnami is among the early players developing distributed quantum sensing platforms, which enable networked sensor arrays for applications in environmental monitoring, infrastructure diagnostics, and secure communications. This positions the company to benefit from the rising demand for scalable, high-precision sensing systems ([macnifico.pt](https://www.macnifico.pt/news-en/distributed-quantum-sensing-devices-market-2025-rapid-growth-driven-by-28-cagr-and-breakthrough-networked-sensing-applications/97985/?utm_source=openai)).

In summary, Qnami’s key opportunities lie in geographic expansion (notably East Asia), deepening its role in semiconductor and materials research, leveraging strategic partnerships and funding, capitalizing on a rapidly growing quantum sensing market, and advancing distributed sensing technologies.
